Name: Vadie's Squirrels for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from Vadie, I've converted her BFAV Squirrels (found [url=http://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/616693-bfav-squirrels]here[/url]  and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4051]here[/url]) so that they'll work with ContentPatcher for SDV 1.6. Credit goes to Vadie for the original mod, and eemie for the squirrel's artwork. Requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher

Squirrels live in coops and produce hazelnuts and ancient seeds.

Enjoy!
